card.name: Digits just before a unit like μ
card.fires_on: A digit inside a number (often the first or middle digit, such as 1, 0 or 5) when a measurement unit such as mCi, μCi, μm, mg/L or mcg/mL comes next. It marks a number still being written before its unit.

modes.label: Radioactivity amounts
modes.description: A digit in a dose written in MBq or mCi/μCi.

modes.label: Concentration ranges
modes.description: A leading digit in a blood level range given in mg/L, mcg/mL or mg/dL.

modes.label: Wavelength or size
modes.description: A digit in a measurement in μm, or in a temperature or length.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write a micro sign (mu, μ, µ) as the next unit prefix.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in a number when a micro-type unit such as μCi or μm is likely to follow.
